title: Saudi Arabia honors Nepali man who defended mosque against attackers - Arab News PK
description: Saudi Arabia honors Nepali man who defended mosque against attackers  Arab News PK
publisher.title: Arab News PK
full_article:
JEDDAH: When a video of a disabled Muslim man defending a mosque in Nepal began circulating on social media, he could hardly have imagined that his moment of courage would eventually take him to Makkah to perform Umrah.

The story dates back to late January, when a widely circulated video showed a Muslim man with one leg, using a crutch and holding a stick as he confronted a crowd attempting to attack a mosque in Nepal’s Rautahat district.

The footage touched people across the Islamic world, while Saudi activists launched a campaign trying to find the man behind the viral video.

Their search eventually succeeded, opening the door to an unforgettable journey for the Nepali man Sheikh Rahemullah, from Rampur, who never expected where he would perform Umrah, be honored for his courage and receive an offer of help that could change his life.

On Aug. 5, 2026, the man arrived in Saudi Arabia with his parents to perform Umrah in Makkah, on a trip sponsored by Saudi donors and organizers in appreciation of his stance in defending the mosque.

The 32-year-old Rahemullah and his parents were welcomed by Saudis and residents of Makkah with gifts and genuine kindness during his stay while performing Umrah.







Sheikh Rahemullah with his mother in Makkah on a trip sponsored by Saudi donors and organizers in appreciation of his stance in defending the mosque. (Supplied)



The initiative extended beyond bringing him to perform Umrah, with Bader Association also undertaking to provide him with a prosthetic limb following the loss of his leg.

One of his companions spoke to Arab News of his happiness at being in the Kingdom and his gratitude to the Saudis who had reached out to him.

Mohammed Rafi, a young Muslim content creator from Kerala, India, who produces Arabic-language visual and cultural content for social media, met the Nepali man and his family and accompanied them during their stay in Saudi Arabia.

He told Arab News: “Thanks first to Allah and then to a number of Saudi brothers, Rahemullah was able to perform Umrah.

“He is (very) happy ... for the hospitality he received and his family in Makkah and Madinah.”

He continued: “I am sure he will never forget ... this trip. His joy at performing Umrah was indescribable, and his story was truly inspiring, embodying patience, steadfastness, and faith.

“May Allah reward our people in Saudi Arabia abundantly, for what they did for this man, and may Allah reward all those who contributed to hosting this heroic man.”

According to Rafi, Rahemullah and his family left for Nepal on Aug. 14, carrying beautiful memories and a feeling of gratitude to the Saudis and to everyone who contributed to this trip.

“ओ (बहुत) खुश छथि ... मक्का आ मदीना मे भेटल सत्कार आ परिवारक लेल।”

ओ आगू कहलनि: “हमरा यकीन अछि जे ओ कहियो नहि बिसरताह ... ई यात्रा। उमरा करै में हुनकऽ आनन्द अवर्णनीय छेलै, आरू हुनकऽ कहानी सही मायने में प्रेरणादायक छेलै, जेकरा में धैर्य, दृढ़ता, आरू आस्था के समाहित छेलै ।

title: How Nepal manages unidentified and unclaimed bodies - The Kathmandu Post
description: How Nepal manages unidentified and unclaimed bodies  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
When an unidentified body is found in Nepal, police begin an investigation to establish the person’s identity and trace relatives before the remains are transferred to a hospital mortuary.

But with 788 unidentified and unclaimed bodies currently being kept in hospital facilities nationwide, limited storage capacity is forcing hospitals to begin disposal procedures within months.

The process starts at the local level. Police notify the relevant local government and ward representatives after an unidentified body is found. Under the Unidentified and Unclaimed Body Management Guidelines, 2021, police prepare an official inquest report in the presence of local representatives and residents.

If relatives are identified during the initial investigation, the body is handed over to them. If no relatives are found, the remains are transferred to a hospital mortuary for preservation while police continue efforts to establish the person’s identity.

According to Nepal Police data, 1,634 unidentified bodies have been recovered nationwide since fiscal year 2013-14. Of these, 133 were identified and handed over to their families, 84 were transferred to teaching hospitals for medical research, and 629 were cremated or buried after the required legal procedures. Another 788 remain in hospital mortuaries, awaiting identification or final disposal.

Deputy Inspector General of police Abi Narayan Kafle, central spokesperson of the police, said detailed records are maintained for every unidentified body.

“The police are always the first to arrive at the scene and complete all preliminary legal procedures,” Kafle said. “We maintain complete records of the deceased. If families looking for missing relatives examine these records carefully, identification becomes significantly easier.”

full_article:
KATHMANDU, Aug. 15: The Embassy of India, Kathmandu celebrated India’s 80th Independence Day on Saturday with a series of programmes highlighting India’s progress, Nepal-India ties and the contribution of Nepali Gorkha soldiers to the Indian Army.

The celebrations began with the singing of Vande Mataram, followed by the unfurling of the Indian national flag, the Tiranga, by Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava. The National Anthem of India was also sung on the occasion.













The Embassy also broadcast the address to the nation delivered by the President of India on the eve of the 80th Independence Day. The address reflected on India’s journey and achievements during the past 79 years.





A major highlight of the programme was the felicitation of the widows and next of kin of 11 Nepali Gorkha soldiers of the Indian Army who died while serving India. The Embassy distributed insurance cheques worth Rs. 82 million to the families of the deceased soldiers.

The programme also featured the felicitation of winners of various competitions organised by the Embassy as part of the Independence Day celebrations. The winners included participants in a painting competition held under the theme ‘Viksit Bharat’ (Developed India), the Viksit Bharat Run and an inter-school quiz competition.

Winners of the special edition of the ‘Bharat Ko Janiye’ Quiz, organised to promote awareness about India among participants, were also felicitated during the ceremony.

In another initiative aimed at supporting education in Nepal, the Embassy provided book grants to 22 educational institutions and libraries across all seven provinces. The initiative is intended to expand access to educational resources and support students and readers through better availability of books and learning materials.

The celebrations also featured cultural performances by teachers and students associated with the Swami Vivekananda Cultural Centre of the Embassy of India in Kathmandu. The participants presented patriotic songs and dances, adding a cultural dimension to the programme.





The Embassy said the Independence Day activities reflected the close people-to-people and institutional ties between Nepal and India while also highlighting India's development journey and its commitment to educational and cultural cooperation with Nepal.





The programme was attended by officials, representatives of various institutions, members of the Indian community and other invited guests.

India celebrates its Independence Day every year on August 15 to commemorate its independence from British colonial rule in 1947. The year 2026 marks the country's 80th Independence Day celebrations.

काठमाण्डू, १५ अगस्त : भारतक दूतावास, काठमांडू शनिदिन भारतक प्रगति, नेपाल-भारत संबंध आ भारतीय सेनामे नेपाली गोरखा जवानक योगदान पर प्रकाश दैत एक श्रृंखलाबद्ध कार्यक्रमक संग भारतक ८०म स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाओल गेल अछि ।

उत्सव के शुरुआत वंदे मातरम के गायन स भेल, तकर बाद नेपाल मे भारतीय राजदूत नवीन श्रीवास्तव द्वारा भारतीय राष्ट्रीय ध्वज तिरंगा के उदघाटन भेल । एहि अवसर पर भारतक राष्ट्रगान सेहो गाओल गेल ।













दूतावास 80म स्वतंत्रता दिवस के पूर्व संध्या पर भारत के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा देल गेल राष्ट्र के संबोधित संबोधन के सेहो प्रसारण केलक। एहि संबोधन मे भारत के यात्रा आओर पिछला 79 साल के उपलब्धि पर चिंतन भेल.





कार्यक्रमक एकटा प्रमुख आकर्षण छल भारतक सेवा करैत काल मृत्यु भेल भारतीय सेनाक ११ नेपाली गोरखा जवानक विधवा आ अगल-बगलक अभिनन्दन । दूतावास 100 रुपया के बीमा चेक वितरित केलक। 8.2 करोड़ मृतक जवानक परिवार के देल गेल।

कार्यक्रम में स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह के तहत दूतावास द्वारा आयोजित विभिन्न प्रतियोगिता के विजेता के अभिनंदन भी करलऽ गेलै । विजेता में ‘विक्षित भारत’ (विकसित भारत) विषय के तहत आयोजित चित्रकला प्रतियोगिता, विक्षित भारत रन आरू अंतर-स्कूल प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेन॑ वाला शामिल छेलै ।

समारोह के दौरान प्रतिभागी के बीच भारत के प्रति जागरूकता बढ़ाबै के लेलऽ आयोजित ‘भारत को जनिए’ प्रश्नोत्तरी के विशेष संस्करण के विजेता सिनी क॑ भी सम्मानित करलऽ गेलै ।

नेपाल मे शिक्षा के सहयोग के उद्देश्य स दोसर पहल मे दूतावास सातू प्रांत के 22 शैक्षणिक संस्थान आ पुस्तकालय के पुस्तक अनुदान प्रदान केलक। इ पहल कें उद्देश्य शैक्षिक संसाधनक कें पहुंच कें विस्तार करनाय आ पुस्तकक आ सीखय कें सामग्री कें बेहतर उपलब्धता कें माध्यम सं छात्रक आ पाठकक कें सहायता करनाय छै.

उत्सव मे काठमांडू स्थित भारत दूतावासक स्वामी विवेकानन्द सांस्कृतिक केन्द्र सँ जुड़ल शिक्षक आ छात्र-छात्रा लोकनिक सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुति सेहो भेल । प्रतिभागी सब देशभक्ति गीत आ नृत्य प्रस्तुत केलनि, जाहि स कार्यक्रम मे सांस्कृतिक आयाम आबि गेल।





दूतावास कहलनि जे, स्वतंत्रता दिवसक गतिविधि मे नेपाल आ भारतक बीच जन-जन आ संस्थागत संबंधक घनिष्ठताक झलक भेटैत अछि, संगहि भारतक विकास यात्रा आ नेपालक संग शैक्षणिक आ सांस्कृतिक सहयोगक प्रति ओकर प्रतिबद्धता पर सेहो प्रकाश देल गेल अछि।





कार्यक्रम मे अधिकारी, विभिन्न संस्थाक प्रतिनिधि, भारतीय समुदायक सदस्य आ अन्य आमंत्रित अतिथि लोकनि भाग लेलनि ।

भारत हर साल 15 अगस्त क॑ 1947 म॑ ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन स॑ आजादी के याद म॑ अपनऽ स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाबै छै ।वर्ष २०२६ म॑ देश केरऽ ८०वां स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाबै के मौका मिलै छै ।

Kathmandu. Nepal has succeeded in winning a medal for the first time in the International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad. Nepali student Siddhant Chaturvedi won a bronze medal in the second International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad held in Astana, Kazakhstan.

Students from various countries around the world participated in the competition held from August 7 to 8, 2026. Four Nepali students participated in the competition. Among them, Siddhant Chaturvedi won a bronze medal, while Menali, Pitambar Lamichhane, and Ayush Yadav received special appreciation.

All four are students of St. Xavier's College located in Maitighar, Kathmandu.

This achievement is considered special for Nepal. Previously, Nepal had participated in the first edition held in Bulgaria in 2024 and the second edition held in Beijing, China in 2025, but could not win any medals.

This time, 649 competitors from 95 countries participated in the competition. The competition was held in two phases on August 7 and 8 in the preliminary round. Participants solved machine learning problems prepared by the international scientific committee using computer systems such as Python and Jupyter Notebook. Medals were determined based on the combined score over two days.

The Nepali team was selected through the National Artificial Intelligence Olympiad Nepal by Himalayan Computational, Linguistic and AI Olympiad in Nepal.

Previously, a national level competition was organized in Nepal to select students. In the 2026 national round, Pitambar Lamichhane was first and Menali was second. Students selected through the same process represented Nepal in the international competition.

'Better results can be achieved with proper preparation'

Chandan Gupta, co-founder and co-chairman of Himalayan Computational, Linguistic and AI Olympiad in Nepal, says that winning a medal for the first time in an international competition is a great achievement for Nepal.

According to him, Nepal could not achieve the expected success in the previous two editions due to insufficient preparation. This time, special attention was given to student identification, training, and preparation.

'We didn't win anything in the first two editions. The honest reason for this is that we participated without adequate preparation. This year we were somewhat prepared and the difference was immediately visible,' Gupta said.

He expressed confidence that Nepal can achieve even better results if more systematic preparation and a nationwide campaign are conducted in the coming years.

Interest in Artificial Intelligence Growing Among Students

According to Himalayan Computational, Linguistic and AI Olympiad in Nepal, this achievement shows the interest and potential of students in the field of artificial intelligence in Nepal.

According to co-founder and co-chairman Chandan Gupta, the Olympiad has provided students with opportunities to learn computer programming, artificial intelligence, and machine learning skills from a young age. He believes this will also help in producing manpower related to artificial intelligence in Nepal.

According to him, if students are identified in time and provided with proper education and training, they can develop the capacity to compete at the international level.

According to the organizers, the International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad aims to develop basic and practical skills in computer programming, artificial intelligence, and machine learning among students. It is expected that such competitions can also help in achieving the government's goal of producing artificial intelligence-related manpower in Nepal.

Financial Support for Participating Teams

The International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad also provided partial financial assistance for Nepal's participation. Similarly, the organizing institution bore half of the team's registration fee and the travel expenses of three members.

Team leader Ayush Adhikari played an important role in the technical preparation of the Nepali team this time. He led the students in the necessary preparations for the competition.

Program coordinator Pragya Joshi handled the management of the national selection phase and participation, while Chandan Gupta also served as an examiner.

The students selected in the final round received special training on machine learning under the leadership of the team leader. The training included basic principles of machine learning, model building, and practical problem-solving.

Plans for More Preparation Next Year

Himalayan Computational, Linguistic and AI Olympiad in Nepal has announced that it will make more extensive preparations for next year's International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad than this year.

According to the organization, there is a plan to expand programs and training from the school level to identify artificial intelligence talent in Nepal. It is expected that Nepal can perform even better next year if talents are identified in time and adequate training is provided.

Nepal winning a medal for the first time in the International Artificial Intelligence Olympiad has presented the potential of Nepali students in the field of artificial intelligence and technology on the international stage.

7 सँ 8 अगस्त 2026 धरि आयोजित एहि प्रतियोगिता मे विश्व भरिक विभिन्न देशक छात्र-छात्रा सब भाग लेलनि। एहि मे सिद्धान्त चतुर्वेदी कए कांस्य पदक भेटल, जखन कि मेनाली, पीताम्बर लामिछाने, आ आयुष यादव कए विशेष सराहना भेटल ।

चारू काठमांडू के मैतीघर में स्थित सेंट जेवियर कॉलेज के छात्र छैथ।

ई उपलब्धि नेपालक लेल विशेष मानल जाइत अछि । एहि सँ पहिने नेपाल २०२४ मे बुल्गारिया मे आयोजित पहिल संस्करण आ २०२५ मे चीन के बीजिंग मे आयोजित दोसर संस्करण मे भाग लेने छल, मुदा कोनो पदक नहि जीत सकल छल ।

एहि बेर 95 देश स 649 प्रतियोगी एहि प्रतियोगिता मे भाग लेलथि। ई प्रतियोगिता 7 आरू 8 अगस्त क॑ दू चरण म॑ प्रारंभिक दौर म॑ आयोजित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । प्रतिभागी सब पायथन आरू जुपिटर नोटबुक जैसनऽ कंप्यूटर सिस्टम के उपयोग करी क॑ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वैज्ञानिक समिति द्वारा तैयार मशीन लर्निंग के समस्या के समाधान करलकै । दू दिन मे भेटल संयुक्त स्कोर क आधार पर पदक निर्धारित कैल गेल।

नेपालक हिमालयन कम्प्यूटेशनल, भाषिक आ ए.आइ.

अहिसँ पहिने नेपालमे छात्रक चयनक लेल राष्ट्रिय स्तरीय प्रतियोगिताक आयोजन कएल गेल छल । 2026 के राष्ट्रीय दौर में पीताम्बर लामिछाने प्रथम एवं मेनाली द्वितीय स्थान पर रहे | एही प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स चयनित छात्र सब अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता में नेपाल के प्रतिनिधित्व केलनि।

'उचित तैयारी सँ नीक परिणाम प्राप्त कयल जा सकैत अछि'।

नेपालके हिमालयन कम्प्यूटेशनल, लिंग्वस्टिक आ ए.आइ.

हुनका अनुसार नेपाल अपर्याप्त तैयारी के कारण पिछला दू संस्करण में अपेक्षित सफलता प्राप्त नै क सकल । एहि बेर छात्रक पहचान, प्रशिक्षण, आ तैयारी पर विशेष ध्यान देल गेल।

'पहिल दू संस्करण मे हम किछु नहि जीत सकलहुं।' एकर ईमानदार कारण ई जे बिना पर्याप्त तैयारी केने हम सब भाग लेलहुं। एहि साल हम सब किछु तैयार छलहुं आ अंतर तुरंत देखबा मे आबि गेल।'

आगामी वर्ष मे बेसी व्यवस्थित तैयारी आ राष्ट्रव्यापी अभियान चलाओल गेल त नेपाल आओर नीक परिणाम प्राप्त क सकैत अछि से विश्वास व्यक्त केलनि ।

छात्रों के बीच बढ़ते हुए आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस में रुचि |

नेपाल के हिमालयन कम्प्यूटेशनल, लिंग्विस्टिकल आ ए.आई.

सह-संस्थापक आरू सह-अध्यक्ष चंदन गुप्ता के अनुसार ओलंपियाड म॑ छात्रऽ क॑ कम उम्र स॑ ही कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस, आरू मशीन लर्निंग स्किल सीखै के मौका मिललऽ छै । हुनकऽ मानना ​​छै कि एकरा स॑ नेपाल म॑ आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस स॑ जुड़लऽ जनशक्ति के उत्पादन म॑ भी मदद मिलतै ।

हुनकऽ अनुसार अगर समय रहते छात्रऽ के पहचान करी क॑ उचित शिक्षा आरू प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ जाय त॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर प॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करै के क्षमता विकसित करी सकै छै ।

आयोजकऽ के अनुसार इंटरनेशनल आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस ओलंपियाड के उद्देश्य छात्रऽ के बीच कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस, आरू मशीन लर्निंग के बुनियादी आरू व्यावहारिक कौशल विकसित करना छै । उम्मीद अछि जे एहि तरहक प्रतियोगिता नेपाल मे आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस सं जुड़ल जनशक्ति के उत्पादन के सरकार के लक्ष्य के पूरा करय मे सेहो मददगार साबित भ सकैत अछि.

भाग लेबय वाला टीम के लेल आर्थिक सहयोग

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस ओलम्पियाडमे नेपालक सहभागिता लेल आंशिक आर्थिक सहयोग सेहो देल गेल छल । तहिना टीमक पंजीकरण शुल्कक आधा आ तीन सदस्यक यात्रा खर्च आयोजन संस्था पर छल ।

एहि बेर नेपाली टीम के तकनीकी तैयारी मे टीम लीडर आयुष अधिकारी के अहम भूमिका छल. प्रतियोगिता के आवश्यक तैयारी में छात्र सब के नेतृत्व केलनि।

कार्यक्रम संयोजक प्रज्ञा जोशी राष्ट्रीय चयन चरण आ सहभागिता के प्रबंधन संभालने छलीह, जखन कि चंदन गुप्ता परीक्षक के रूप मे सेहो काज केलनि।

अंतिम दौर मे चुनल गेल छात्र कए टीम लीडर क नेतृत्व मे मशीन लर्निंग पर विशेष प्रशिक्षण देल गेल। प्रशिक्षण मे मशीन लर्निंग, मॉडल बिल्डिंग, आ व्यावहारिक समस्या समाधान कें बुनियादी सिद्धांत शामिल छल.

अगिला साल बेसी तैयारी के योजना

नेपालके हिमालयन कम्प्यूटेशनल, भाषिक आ ए.आइ.

संस्था के अनुसार नेपाल मे आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस प्रतिभा के पहचान करय लेल स्कूल स्तर स कार्यक्रम आ प्रशिक्षण के विस्तार के योजना अछि। समय रहते प्रतिभा के पहचान क पर्याप्त प्रशिक्षण देल जाय त अगिला साल नेपाल आओर नीक प्रदर्शन क सकैत अछि।

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस ओलम्पियाडमे नेपालके पहिल बेर पदक जितलासँ आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस आ टेक्नोलॉजीके क्षेत्रमे नेपाली विद्यार्थीसबके सम्भावना अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय पटलमे प्रस्तुत भेल अछि ।

Kathmandu, Aug 15: House of Representatives (HoR) Speaker Dol Prasad Aryal has expressed his full commitments to the preservation and promotion of literature, art and culture, describing them as national treasurers.

Addressing an awards ceremony organised here on Saturday by the Noor- Ganga Talent Award ( Pratibha Puraskar) Guthi, the Speaker said the preservation and promotion of the country's literature, art and culture is a shared responsibility.

According to him, Nepal has earned recognition in the global arena for its language, literature, art and culture and it is essential to promote and honour the talents from these areas. "Our language and literature are integral to our identity."

The Speaker was of the view that talents and writers who remain unrecognized in different parts of the country should be identified and given national recognition.

Guthi Chair Pro Dr Govinda Nepali said the organization has been actively working for the development and promotion of Nepali literature.(RSS)

शनिदिन नूर- गंगा प्रतिभा पुरस्कार ( प्रतिभा पुरस्कार) गुठी द्वारा आयोजित पुरस्कार समारोह के संबोधित करैत सभापति कहलनि जे देश के साहित्य, कला आ संस्कृति के संरक्षण आ संवर्धन एकटा साझा जिम्मेदारी अछि।

हुनका अनुसार नेपाल अपन भाषा, साहित्य, कला आ संस्कृति के लेल वैश्विक क्षेत्र में पहचान अर्जित केलक अछि आ एहि क्षेत्र के प्रतिभा के बढ़ावा देबय आ सम्मानित करब अनिवार्य अछि। "हमरऽ भाषा आरू साहित्य हमरऽ पहचान के अभिन्न अंग छै।"

सभापति केरऽ विचार छेलै कि देश केरऽ विभिन्न भागऽ में जे प्रतिभा आरू साहित्यकारऽ के पहचान नै होय रहलऽ छै, ओकरऽ पहचान करी क॑ राष्ट्रीय मान्यता देलऽ जाय ।

गुठी चेयर प्रो डॉ गोविन्द नेपाली नेपाली साहित्य के विकास आ संवर्धन के लेल संस्था सक्रिय रूप स कार्यरत रहल बतौलनि ।(RSS)

title: Nepal Golf Association Partners with Guangzhou ADAY GOLF Sports Development Company - Ratopati
description: Nepal Golf Association Partners with Guangzhou ADAY GOLF Sports Development Company  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A cooperation agreement has been reached between the Nepal Golf Association and China's Guangzhou ADAY GOLF Sports Development Company Limited with the objective of developing and promoting Nepali golf at the international level.

The agreement was signed by Tashi Ghale, President of the Nepal Golf Association, and Huang Go Mei, President of Guangzhou ADAY GOLF Sports Development Company.

According to the agreement, the Nepali golf team will get the opportunity to train in Guangzhou, China. Both parties will cooperate in providing an international standard training environment for Nepali players, constructing a golf academy in Nepal, exchanging players and coaches, and promoting golf tourism.

After the agreement, Mark Tui, co-founder of Guangzhou ADAY GOLF Sports Development Company, stated that ADAY is one of the largest golf companies in China. He also expressed commitment to supporting the development of the sport by organizing various golf competitions in Nepal and China.

Preparation to build a golf academy in Nepal

Tashi Ghale, President of the Nepal Golf Association, said that the development of golf in Nepal is still in its early stages.

According to him, the association is currently prioritizing the development of junior golf. He stated that there is a need to expand training and opportunities for producing new players.

Ghale also informed that the association is making efforts for the government to provide land for the construction of a golf academy.

He expressed confidence that the agreement with China's ADAY will significantly contribute to the development of Nepali golf.

"The development of golf in Nepal is still in its initial phase. We are particularly focused on the development of junior players. A golf academy is necessary for producing players and for training. For that, we are requesting land from the government," Ghale said.

Sports attire for the golf team for the Asiad

On the same occasion, sports attire was also handed over to the Nepali golf team participating in the Asian Games to be held in Japan.

Waldo Dynasty Ang Ho Nepal has sponsored the sports attire for the players, coaches, and officials of the Nepali golf team.

Waldo Dynasty Ang Ho Nepal President Steward Chong handed over the attire to be used by the national team in the Asian Games to Nepal Golf Association President Ghale.

President Ghale expressed gratitude to Waldo Dynasty Ang Ho Nepal for providing the attire to the Nepali team. He informed that all players of the Nepali golf team will use the attire in the Asian Games.

"We have been cooperating with Nepal for a long time"

Waldo Dynasty Ang Ho Nepal President Steward Chong said that they have been supporting Nepal's participation in various international sports through uniforms since 2014.

He stated that they are happy to be associated with the Nepali golf team this time.

Although Nepal has been increasing its participation in international competitions in golf recently, there are still challenges in player production, training, and infrastructure. The Nepal Golf Association believes that the new cooperation with China and the support from the private sector will help to some extent in solving these challenges.

The association states that by expanding opportunities for golf academy construction, youth player production, coach capacity building, and international training, Nepali golf can be strengthened in the long term.
translated:
काठमांडू। नेपाल गोल्फ संघ आ चीनक ग्वांगझौ ADAY GOLF स्पोर्ट्स डेवलपमेंट कम्पनी लिमिटेड के बीच अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्तर पर नेपाली गोल्फ के विकास आ प्रचार प्रसार के उद्देश्य स सहयोग समझौता भेल अछि ।

एहि समझौता पर नेपाल गोल्फ संघक अध्यक्ष ताशी घाले आ ग्वांगझौ ADAY GOLF स्पोर्ट्स डेवलपमेंट कम्पनीक अध्यक्ष हुआंग गो मेई हस्ताक्षर केने छथि ।

समझौता के अनुसार नेपाली गोल्फ टीम के चीन के ग्वांगझू में प्रशिक्षण लेबाक अवसर भेटत। नेपाली खिलाड़ी के लेल अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक प्रशिक्षण वातावरण उपलब्ध कराबय, नेपाल में गोल्फ अकादमी के निर्माण, खिलाड़ी आ कोच के आदान-प्रदान, गोल्फ पर्यटन के बढ़ावा देबय में दुनू पक्ष सहयोग करत।

समझौता के बाद ग्वांगझू एडे गोल्फ स्पोर्ट्स डेवलपमेंट कंपनी के सह-संस्थापक मार्क तुई न॑ कहलकै कि एडीए चीन केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ गोल्फ कंपनी म॑ स॑ एक छै । संगहि नेपाल आ चीन मे विभिन्न गोल्फ प्रतियोगिताक आयोजन कए एहि खेलक विकास मे सहयोग करबाक प्रतिबद्धता व्यक्त केलनि ।

नेपाल मे गोल्फ अकादमी बनेबाक तैयारी

नेपाल गोल्फ संघके अध्यक्ष ताशी घाले नेपालमे गोल्फके विकास अखनो प्रारंभिक अवस्थामे रहल बटैलै ।

हुनकऽ अनुसार एसोसिएशन अभी जूनियर गोल्फ के विकास क॑ प्राथमिकता द॑ रहलऽ छै । हुनी कहलकै कि प्रशिक्षण आरू नया खिलाड़ी पैदा करै के अवसर के विस्तार के जरूरत छै ।

घाले न॑ ई भी जानकारी देलकै कि एसोसिएशन न॑ सरकार लेली गोल्फ अकादमी के निर्माण लेली जमीन उपलब्ध करै के प्रयास करी रहलऽ छै ।

चीन के एडीएई के साथ भेल समझौता स॑ नेपाली गोल्फ के विकास म॑ काफी योगदान मिलतै, ई बात के विश्वास व्यक्त करलकै ।

घले कहलनि जे, नेपाल मे गोल्फ के विकास एखनहु प्रारंभिक चरण मे अछि, हम सब विशेष रूप स जूनियर खिलाड़ी के विकास पर ध्यान केंद्रित क रहल छी, खिलाड़ी के उत्पादन आ प्रशिक्षण के लेल गोल्फ अकादमी जरूरी अछि, ताहि लेल हम सब सरकार स जमीन के आग्रह क रहल छी।

एशियाड के लिये गोल्फ टीम के लिये खेल परिधान

ओही अवसर पर जापान मे होबय बला एशियाई खेल मे भाग लेबय वाला नेपाली गोल्फ टीम के खेल परिधान सेहो सौंपल गेल छल.

वाल्दो राजवंश आंग हो नेपाल नेपाली गोल्फ टीमक खिलाड़ी, कोच, आ अधिकारी सभक लेल खेल परिधान प्रायोजित केने अछि ।

वाल्दो वंश आंग हो नेपालक अध्यक्ष स्टुअर्ड चोङ नेपाल गोल्फ संघक अध्यक्ष घले केँ एशियन खेलमे राष्ट्रिय टीम द्वारा प्रयोग होमय बला परिधान सौंपलनि ।

राष्ट्रपति घले नेपाली टीम के परिधान उपलब्ध कराबय लेल वाल्दो वंश आंग हो नेपाल के आभार व्यक्त केलनि । ओ नेपाली गोल्फ टीमक सभ खिलाड़ी एशियन खेलमे एहि परिधानक उपयोग करताह से जानकारी देलनि ।

"हम सब नेपाल के साथ बहुत दिन स सहयोग क रहल छी"।

वाल्दो वंश आंग हो नेपालक अध्यक्ष स्टीवर्ड चोंग २०१४ सँ वर्दी मार्फत नेपालक विभिन्न अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेलमे सहभागितामे सहयोग करैत रहल बतौलनि ।

ओ कहलनि जे, एहि बेर नेपाली गोल्फ टीम सं जुड़ि कए ओ सब खुश छथि।

हालांकि हाल मे नेपाल गोल्फ मे अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता मे अपन भागीदारी बढ़ा रहल अछि, मुदा खिलाड़ी उत्पादन, प्रशिक्षण, आ बुनियादी ढांचा मे एखनो चुनौती अछि । नेपाल गोल्फ संघ के विश्वास छै कि चीन के साथ नया सहयोग आरू निजी क्षेत्र के सहयोग स॑ ई चुनौती के समाधान म॑ कुछ हद तलक मदद मिलतै ।

संघ के कहना छै कि गोल्फ अकादमी निर्माण, युवा खिलाड़ी उत्पादन, कोच क्षमता निर्माण, आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रशिक्षण के अवसर के विस्तार करी क॑ नेपाली गोल्फ क॑ दीर्घकाल म॑ मजबूत करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।
